_about: Documents with different structures. 'expected' is what a correct extraction must contain. P4 uses a structure no few-shot example shows (an 'Approach' label and footnote-style 'Notes').

documents.text:
Title: Soil moisture and seedling survival in dryland wheat
Methods: We ran a randomized block trial on 24 plots over two seasons, measuring volumetric soil moisture weekly.
Results: Survival rose with moisture (Okafor et al., 2021), consistent with earlier field work (Lindqvist, 2019). Each plot received 250 mL of nutrient solution per week.

documents.structure: no Methods heading (method embedded in narrative), numbered references with a bibliography
documents.text:
Title: Night-shift scheduling and medication errors
Medication errors cluster in the last two hours of a shift [1]. To test this, we interviewed 42 nurses across three hospitals over eight weeks and matched their shift logs to incident reports. Errors fell by a third after shifts were capped at ten hours [2].
References
1. Haddad, R. (2020). Fatigue and error in clinical practice. Journal of Nursing Safety.
2. Brennan, T., & Cho, L. (2022). Shift length policy outcomes. Health Policy Review.

documents.structure: informal field notes, informal measurements, citation inside a sentence
documents.text:
Title: Sourdough starter vigor at altitude
Field notes, day 3. Following the feeding schedule from Moreau's 2018 baking handbook, we mixed a couple of cups of flour with about half a cup of water and a pinch of salt, then left the jar at 2,400 m for 12 hours.

documents.structure: 'Approach' label instead of Methods, footnote-style Notes, informal quantity
documents.text:
Title: Urban beehive yields
Approach: Twelve rooftop hives were weighed monthly for a year; yield is the weight gained between April and September.
Hives fed roughly a dozen grams of pollen patty each in March produced more honey.^1
Notes
^1 Ferreira, M. (2017). Supplemental feeding in urban apiaries. Apidologie Letters.
